paragraphs.text: Learn to make bowls and cups on a potter’s wheel. Classes run on Monday evenings for eight weeks. All clay and tools are provided, but please bring an apron. The maximum group size is ten.
Explore the old town with your camera and learn how to take better pictures in low light. We meet at the museum entrance at 7 pm every Wednesday. Suitable for both phone and camera users.
Cook a three-course Italian meal each week and eat it together at the end of the class. Ingredients are included in the price. Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book.

items.quote: Explore the old town with your camera

explanation.en: “Explore the old town with your camera”, meeting at the museum — the class is a walk around town → B.
explanation.kk: «Explore the old town with your camera» және мұражай алдында кездесу — сабақ қаланы аралау кезінде өтеді → B.
explanation.ru: «Explore the old town with your camera» и встреча у музея — занятие проходит на прогулке по городу → B.

items.quote: Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book
items.prompt: asks for information when you book

explanation.en: “Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book” → C. A asks you to bring an apron, but that is not information given when booking.
explanation.kk: «Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book» → C. A-да алжапқыш әкелуді сұрайды, бірақ бұл тіркелу кезіндегі ақпарат емес.
explanation.ru: «Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book» → C. В A просят принести фартук, но это не информация при записи.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–2. Look at the three evening classes, A–C. Which class mentions the following? Write the correct letter, A–C.

steps.en: The instruction: which of the three texts, A–C, mentions the information. The answer is a text letter.
steps.kk: Нұсқаулық: A–C үш мәтіннің қайсысында ақпарат бар. Жауап — мәтіннің әрпі.
steps.ru: Инструкция: какой из трёх текстов A–C упоминает информацию. Ответ — буква текста.

steps.en: The item “walking around the town”: look for a class that happens outside, by meaning rather than the word “walk”.
steps.kk: «walking around the town» тармағы — сабақ далада өтетін мәтінді сөзге емес, мағынаға қарап іздейміз.
steps.ru: Пункт «walking around the town» — ищем текст, где занятие проходит на улице, по смыслу, а не по слову «walk».

steps.en: In B: “Explore the old town with your camera”, meeting “at the museum entrance”. That is a walk around town → B.
steps.kk: B-де: «Explore the old town with your camera» және «at the museum entrance» кездесу. Бұл — қаланы аралау → B.
steps.ru: В B: «Explore the old town with your camera» и встреча «at the museum entrance». Это прогулка по городу → B.

steps.en: The item “asks for information when you book” — look for a text asking you to tell them something when booking.
steps.kk: «asks for information when you book» тармағы — тіркелгенде бір нәрсе хабарлауды сұрайтын мәтін керек.
steps.ru: Пункт «asks for information when you book» — нужен текст, где при записи просят что-то сообщить.

steps.en: A asks you to bring an apron — an item for class, not information when booking.
steps.kk: A алжапқыш әкелуді сұрайды — бұл тіркелу кезіндегі ақпарат емес, сабаққа керек зат.
steps.ru: A просит принести фартук — это вещь на занятие, а не информация при записи.

steps.en: C: “Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book” — that is it → C.
steps.kk: C: «Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book» — дәл осы → C.
steps.ru: C: «Please tell us about any foods you cannot eat when you book» — это то, что нужно → C.
